facts.text: I was sitting on the edge of a roof thinking about suicide.
My dad died from a heart attack.
I had to attend my dad’s funeral tomorrow.
I had to deliver a eulogy at my dad’s funeral.
My father was strict, abusive, and old-fashioned.
My father beat me and my brother as punishment and discipline.
My father beat my mom from time to time.
My father verbally abused my brother by calling him “Fatso.”
My father provided for and protected me and my brother.
My mom called me and asked if I could deliver the eulogy.
I lied to my mom and told her I had finished writing the eulogy.
It took me 3 hours to write the eulogy.
I went to sleep after writing the eulogy and it was 2:00 AM.
I woke up at 8:00 AM the next day to attend the funeral.
I drove to the cemetery to attend my father’s funeral.
I delivered the eulogy at the podium and my voice was getting weaker.
My mom asked me to stay with her in her apartment while she copes.
I told my mom I would stay with her and that I couldn’t leave her alone.
I offered to drive my mom to her apartment instead of taking the bus.
My car radio used Bluetooth instead of an auxiliary cord.
I typed in my car radio password to connect my phone.
I recognized a song my mom played because I used to listen to it every day as a kid.
I rushed to my childhood bedroom when we arrived at my mom’s apartment.
My mom told me she would go take a nap at 4 pm.
My mom asked me to drink afternoon tea with her.
My mom had two cups of tea and a few pieces of cake set out.
My mom became dizzy and numb.
I called 911 because my mom was suffering a stroke with dizziness and numbness.
My mom was conscious when I spoke to the 911 operator.
I gave the 911 operator my address as 0214 97 olive avenue Ave Lane house 198.
My mom passed out/fainted after I called 911.
I waited for the ambulance and opened the door for the paramedics.
My mom lived on the 9th floor.
I rode in the ambulance to the hospital with the paramedics.
The paramedics told me they thought my mom had a stroke and that her blood was leaking in her brain.
Doctors told me my mom was in a coma.
I sat by my mom’s hospital bed day and night.
I got fired from my job because I didn’t notify my supervisor I would be on leave.
I am drowning in medical bills and debts.

events.text: My dad died from a heart attack.
I wrote a eulogy over 3 hours and it was 2:00 AM when I finished.
I woke up at 8:00 AM and went to my father’s funeral.
My mom took a nap at 4 pm and later became dizzy and numb.
I called 911 for my mom’s stroke and gave my address to the operator.
My mom was taken to the hospital and later doctors told me she was in a coma.
I sat by my mom’s hospital bed day and night and got fired from my job.
